name: arXiv:2601.04426 - XGrammar-2: Dynamic and Efficient Structured Generation Engine for Agentic LLMs
notes: arXiv:2601.04426, v1 2026-01-07, latest v4 2026-08-05. arXiv comment reads '9 pages, ACM CAIS 26' and the Atom feed carries journal_ref DOI 10.1145/3786335.3813124. The venue is recorded from the CROSSREF deposit (CAIS '26, ACM Conference on AI and Agentic Systems, San Jose, published 2026-05-26, pages 1009-1022) rather than from the comment string, because a bare acronym in a comment field is exactly the kind of value this repo has gotten wrong. CAIS has no entry in the paper schema's venue enum, so venue is recorded as 'other' with the authoritative name in notes. Authors Linzhang Li, Yixin Dong, Guanjie Wang, Ziyi Xu, Alexander Jiang, Tianqi Chen.
